entities.summary: Volha Henadzyeuna Sitnik is a Belarusian activist and Wikipedian. She is an administrator of the Belarusian Wikipedia in its official orthography. She has contributed thousands of articles and hundreds of thousands of edits. Since April 2025, she has been detained multiple times and, together with other Wikipedians, has been implicated in an unspecified criminal case. She has been recognized as a political prisoner by human rights organizations.
